_comment: Seasons (docs/mechanics/01-world-and-run.md#seasons): each lasts `dayHours` game hours (one game day), in `order`, from the run's start, then round again. A season's `grain` is added to the grain production factor (1: twice the grain, -1: none at all), on top of every other bonus, in every settlement, while it lasts. `defense` is added to every unit's defense in every battle, players' and hordes' alike (0.2: 20% better). `fronts` multiplies how likely each front is to send the day's horde (a front not named: 1; 0: none from it); the horde's front is drawn by these weights, for the season it sets out in. `art` names how the map looks (the client).

spring.name: Spring
spring.description: The thaw: the land wakes, and every front stirs alike.

summer.name: Summer
summer.description: The fields ripen: twice the grain. The steppe riders ride twice as often; the Order's armies, slow in the heat, half as often.

autumn.name: Autumn
autumn.description: The harvest is in and the ground is firm: every soldier holds 20% better. The Order marches half as often again; the nomads go home to winter.

winter.name: Winter
winter.description: Snow on the fields: no grain at all, the stores must last. The Monsters of the North come twice as often.
